workflow_rationale: This is a feature enhancement workflow that extends existing admin functionality with new UI components (variants, image upload, refunds, invoices, customer history, analytics). Core infrastructure exists (NextAuth, RBAC, API routes, Prisma models) - this task adds missing UI features to complete the admin panel.

phases.name: Product Variant Management UI
phases.description: Build UI for adding, editing, and deleting product variants in the product editor

subtasks.description: Create VariantEditor component with add/edit/delete functionality
subtasks.notes:
Successfully created VariantEditor component with full CRUD functionality. Component includes:
- Table display of existing variants with columns for Name, Type, Price Override, SKU, and Stock Status
- Add Variant dialog with form validation using shadcn/ui components
- Edit dialog for updating existing variants
- Delete confirmation dialog with safety prompt
- Proper error handling and loading states
- API integration for POST (create), PUT (update), and DELETE operations
- Clean UI following existing admin patterns from RefundDialog
- Badge components for stock status
- Price validation allowing optional decimal values
- Type selection dropdown (size, flavor, heat, pack, other)
- Optional SKU and price override fields
Verification passed successfully. Changes committed to git.

subtasks.description: Integrate VariantEditor into product editor page

verification.instructions: Navigate to /admin/products/[id]/edit - verify Variant section renders with table showing existing variants and Add Variant button

subtasks.notes:
Successfully integrated VariantEditor into product editor page. Created VariantEditorWrapper component to handle client-side router.refresh() after variant updates. Modified product-editor-page.tsx to:
1. Import VariantEditorWrapper component
2. Fetch variants from database using prisma.productVariant.findMany
3. Pass productId and variants to VariantEditorWrapper
4. Render VariantEditor section below ProductForm

The VariantEditor will now display on /admin/products/[id]/edit showing:
- Table of existing variants with columns for Name, Type, Price Override, SKU, and Stock
- Add Variant button to create new variants
- Edit and Delete actions for each variant
- Automatic page refresh after CRUD operations via router.refresh()

Changes committed to git successfully.

subtasks.description: Create API route for variant CRUD operations
subtasks.notes:
Successfully created API routes for product variant CRUD operations:

1. Created POST /api/admin/products/[id]/variants for creating new variants
   - Validates required fields (name, type)
   - Validates optional price (must be positive number)
   - Checks for duplicate SKU if provided
   - Verifies product exists before creating variant
   - Returns 201 status on success

2. Created GET /api/admin/products/[id]/variants for listing all variants of a product
   - Returns variants ordered by creation date
   - Verifies product exists

3. Created PUT /api/admin/products/[id]/variants/[variantId] for updating variants
   - Validates all fields (same as POST)
   - Verifies variant exists and belongs to the specified product
   - Checks for SKU conflicts when changing SKU
   - Tracks before/after changes in audit log

4. Created DELETE /api/admin/products/[id]/variants/[variantId] for deleting variants
   - Verifies variant exists and belongs to the specified product
   - Logs deleted variant details in audit trail

All endpoints:
- Enforce RBAC permissions (products:write for mutations, products:read for queries)
- Include comprehensive audit logging via logAuditWithRequest
- Follow patterns from app/api/admin/orders/[id]/refund/route.ts
- Use ok/fail helpers from lib/api.ts for consistent responses
- Handle errors gracefully with appropriate HTTP status codes

The API routes integrate seamlessly with the VariantEditor component created in subtask-2-1, providing full CRUD functionality for product variants.

phases.name: Product Image Upload UI
phases.description: Add image upload interface to product editor with preview and featured image selection

subtasks.description: Create ImageUploader component with preview and multi-upload support
subtasks.notes: Created ImageUploader component following PhotoGalleryInput patterns. Supports multi-upload, preview, alt text, and max image limits. Includes error handling for failed image loads.

subtasks.description: Create server action for Vercel Blob image upload
subtasks.notes:
Successfully created server action for Vercel Blob image upload at app/admin/products/_actions/upload-image.ts. The action includes:
- 'use server' directive for Next.js server actions
- Permission check using requirePermission('products:write')
- File validation (type and size checks)
- Image upload to Vercel Blob with public access
- Unique filename generation with timestamp and 'products/' prefix
- Comprehensive error handling for permissions, authentication, and Blob API errors
- TypeScript interface for return type (UploadImageResult)
- File size limit of 4.5MB (Vercel server upload limit)
- Sanitization of filenames to prevent path traversal

The function accepts FormData with a 'file' field and returns a result object with success status and either the blob URL or an error message. Ready for integration into ImageUploader component in subtask-3-3.

subtasks.description: Integrate ImageUploader into product editor
subtasks.notes:
Successfully integrated ImageUploader into product editor page. Created ImageUploaderWrapper client component to handle image state management and auto-save functionality. The wrapper:
- Displays existing product images from database
- Allows adding/removing images via the ImageUploader component  
- Auto-saves image changes to the database via PATCH /api/admin/products/[id]
- Shows save status indicator
- Supports up to 10 images with preview thumbnails
- Allows editing alt text for each image

The ImageUploader section now appears above the ProductForm on the product editor page at /admin/products/[id]/edit, following the same pattern as VariantEditorWrapper integration. Changes committed successfully.

description:
# Admin Dashboard & Content Management

**Linear Issue:** [JLA-17](https://linear.app/jlangdev/issue/JLA-17/admin-dashboard-and-content-management)
**Priority:** High
**Status:** Todo
**Labels:** ✨ Feature Request

## Description

**Admin Dashboard**

Build admin panel for managing products, orders, and content.

**Tasks:**

- [ ] Set up admin authentication
- [ ] Create admin layout and navigation
- [ ] Build product management interface
  - [ ] Add/edit/delete products
  - [ ] Upload product images
  - [ ] Manage variants
- [ ] Build order management interface
  - [ ] View all orders
  - [ ] Update order status
  - [ ] Process refunds
  - [ ] Print invoices
- [ ] Build customer management
  - [ ] View customer list
  - [ ] View customer orders
- [ ] Analytics dashboard
  - [ ] Sales metrics
  - [ ] Popular products
  - [ ] Revenue charts

**Tech Stack:**

* Next.js protected routes
* shadcn/ui components (Tables, Forms, Charts)
* TypeScript
* Role-based access control

**Pages:**

* /admin/dashboard
* /admin/products
* /admin/orders
* /admin/customers
* /admin/analytics
